name: Corix
summary: Corix carries a body finished in brass metallic paint, giving it a warm, modern sheen with a solid visual weight. The drawer front is wrapped in light grey matte elm veneer, adding a soft, textured contrast to the metallic surface. Inside, melamine lining keeps the drawer interior crisp and practical, completing a design that feels refined and deliberately composed. The body paint in brass metallic, drawer front panel cover with elm veneer in light gray matt. drawer inner with melamine. 55x40x45
